basic_details.job_title: UCMS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 Project Research Scientist, Project Technical Support and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Multi-disciplinary Research Unit (MRU) of University College of Medical Science (University of Delhi) and Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital, Delhi has invited applications for 8 contractual posts in the CoRE Project: Project Research Scientist-I (1), Project Research Scientist-II (1), Project Technical Support-I (2), Project Technical Support-II (2) and Project Technical Support-III (2). Pay ranges from Rs. 18000 to Rs. 67000 plus HRA. Applications are sent by email to [email protected], to reach by 1 December 2026, 4:00 PM.

qualification.details: Project Research Scientist-I: overall data management for all research studies under CoRE and MRU. Project Research Scientist-II: overall data management, preferably data analysis and statistical support for all research studies under CoRE and MRU. | The notice prints no desirable qualification for the three Project Technical Support posts. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Fill the application format printed in the notice (post applied for, personal details, qualifications and experience in chronological order, declaration, signature, photograph).

Email the PDF, along with biodata, certificates and relevant publications, to [email protected].
Write "Application for the post of ………………………" with the post name in the email subject.
Fill the Google form https://forms.gle/iQYrnbRnyLSeY1vm7. A separate form is to be submitted for each post.
Make sure the application is received by 1 December 2026, 4:00 PM. Applications after that time and incomplete applications are rejected.

content_sections.heading: About UCMS
content_sections.text: University College of Medical Science (University of Delhi) & Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital is based at Delhi – 110095. This recruitment is run by its Multi-disciplinary Research Unit for the CoRE Project, and the notice is signed by the Nodal Officer-MRU. The notice gives the telephone as 22582972-4, Extn 1405, and the fax as 0091-11-22590495.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 8 posts in total. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own age limit and qualification, shown below. The age cut-off is the last date of submission of the application form. Age relaxation is as per ICMR-DHR norms (government servants, and SC/ST/OBC candidates in accordance with Department of Personnel and Training instructions). Project Research Scientist-I: overall data management for all research studies under CoRE and MRU. Project Research Scientist-II: overall data management, preferably data analysis and statistical support for all research studies under CoRE and MRU. The notice prints no desirable qualification for the three Project Technical Support posts. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: First class post-graduate degree, including integrated PG degrees; OR second class post-graduate degree, including integrated PG degrees, with PhD; OR for Engineering/IT/CS, first class graduate degree of four years.

First class post-graduate degree, including integrated PG degrees, with three year experience or PhD; OR second class post-graduate degree with PhD and three years experience; OR for Engineering/IT/CS, first class four-year graduate degree with three years experience.
10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI) + two year experience in relevant subject/field.
12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering) + five year experience in relevant subject/field.
Three year graduate in relevant subject/field + three year experience, or PG in relevant subject/field; OR for Engineering/IT/CS, first class four year graduate degree + three year experience.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All posts are on a contractual basis for one year, extendable for a further period subject to satisfactory performance and other considerations, up to the Finance Commission Cycle of 5 years. The pay is printed as emoluments plus HRA. Provident Fund, Leave Travel Concession, Medical Claim and CCA are not available to the project employee. Either side can end the appointment by giving 30 days' notice or salary in lieu.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UCMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application format printed in the notice (post applied for, personal details, qualifications and experience in chronological order, declaration, signature, photograph). Scan the form with self-attested supporting documents as per the checklist, combined in a single PDF, with documents in chronological order (qualification and experience). Email the PDF, along with biodata, certificates and relevant publications, to [email protected] . Write "Application for the post of ………………………" with the post name in the email subject. Fill the Google form https://forms.gle/iQYrnbRnyLSeY1vm7 . A separate form is to be submitted for each post. Make sure the application is received by 1 December 2026, 4:00 PM. Applications after that time and incomplete applications are rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Named in the Notice
content_sections.text: ID proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID or Driving Licence) Class X marksheet or age proof; Class XII marksheet Graduation, Post Graduate and PhD marksheets/certificates Any other qualifications; experience and publications (if any) NOC (for government employees) Two photographs, on the day of interview/written exam The printed hard copy of the filled form with self-attested documents must be produced on the day of interview, with originals for verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the date and time of the interview by email. The notice also says candidates will be intimated about the interview/written test by email. The notice gives the venue and dates of the interview as not announced. The syllabus is printed for each of these three posts: an MCQ test of 50 questions, 1 mark each, no negative marking, duration 1 hour.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in UCMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 posts: 1 Project Research Scientist-I, 1 Project Research Scientist-II, and 2 each of Project Technical Support-I, II and III.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach [email protected] by 1 December 2026, 4:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Technical Support-I?
faq.answer: 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI) + two year experience in relevant subject/field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: It varies by post: 35 years for Project Research Scientist-I, 40 for Project Research Scientist-II, 28 for Project Technical Support-I, 30 for Project Technical Support-II and 35 for Project Technical Support-III, counted on the last date of submission of the application form.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Rs. 56000 + HRA (Project Research Scientist-I), Rs. 67000 + HRA (Project Research Scientist-II), Rs. 18000 + HRA (Project Technical Support-I), Rs. 20000 + HRA (Project Technical Support-II) and Rs. 28000 + HRA (Project Technical Support-III).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the filled form with self-attested documents as a single PDF to [email protected], with "Application for the post of ..." in the subject, and fill the Google form https://forms.gle/iQYrnbRnyLSeY1vm7.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: The notice says a separate Google form should be submitted for each post.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a written test?
faq.answer: A written MCQ test of 50 questions, 1 hour and no negative marking is described for Project Technical Support-I, II and III. Shortlisted candidates are told of the interview by email.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are contractual for one year, extendable up to the Finance Commission Cycle of 5 years, with no right to regular or permanent employment.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states no TA/DA will be paid.
